200.why: Passes split A/B (both LOW); checked the photo, transcribed correctly. All four options are false of thermoplastics (they soften on heating, can be remoulded and recycled); A, C and D describe thermosetting plastics. B is the likely intent ('deformed by heating').
200.reasoning: Thermoplastics, like polythene and PVC, soften when heated and can be moulded again and again, so they can be recycled. Plastics that cannot be remoulded or melted, like bakelite, are thermosetting plastics. So options (1), (3) and (4) describe thermosetting plastics, and option (2) is true only if 'destroyed' means 'deformed' (softened) by heating.
200.notice: As printed no option is right: thermoplastics soften when heated and can be remoulded and recycled. Options (1), (3) and (4) describe thermosetting plastics, and (2) is right only if it means 'deformed by heating'. In PYQ Vault mocks this question is awarded to every candidate.
